page.overview:
Who is Nell Chilton?

Ensign Nell Chilton was the conn officer aboard the under the command of Captain Beverly Picard in an unknown, future timeframe.

Chilton was killed during an attack on the Pasteur by several Klingon attack cruisers, when the helm console exploded. She was the only casualty before the ship was rescued by Admiral Riker and the . This timeline was replaced by a new one where the anti-time eruption never existed. ()
